profiles.catboost: numeric NaN retained, missing categories converted to explicit strings
profiles.lightgbm: numeric NaN retained, categorical dtypes frozen from training vocabulary, zero_as_missing=False

all_profiles: missing indicator for every numeric feature; unknown categories explicit; signed labels, zeros and extreme observed targets kept; targets and quality flags excluded from features
fitting_rule: Fresh pipeline fitted only on select_training_rows at each forecast time. Never fit preprocessing globally or on prediction rows.
model_parameters: Initial factory defaults only, not tuned or recommended final hyperparameters
